question: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations was established in which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangkok**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)** was established on **8 August 1967** in **Bangkok, Thailand**, through the signing of the **Bangkok Declaration** (also known as the ASEAN Declaration).
 
• The founding members of ASEAN include **Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore,** and **Thailand**, who signed the Bangkok Declaration to promote economic cooperation, cultural exchange, and regional stability.
 
• The **Bangkok Declaration** emphasized the principles of equality, partnership, and mutual respect among the member nations, forming the foundation for ASEAN’s objectives.
 
• The main goals of ASEAN are to accelerate **economic growth**, promote **social progress**, and ensure **regional peace and stability**.
 
• The ASEAN Secretariat, which facilitates the coordination of activities and implementation of decisions, is located in **Jakarta, Indonesia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Bangkok Declaration:**

 
 
• The Bangkok Declaration is the founding document of ASEAN, signed on **8 August 1967**.
 
• It laid the foundation for cooperation in various fields such as **economic development, social progress, cultural exchange, and regional stability**.
 
• It emphasized the importance of **non-interference** in the internal affairs of member states and the promotion of **peaceful dispute resolution**.
 
 
 
• **ASEAN Member States:**
 
 
• Initially, ASEAN had **5 founding members**: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.
 
• Over time, additional countries joined ASEAN, including **Brunei (1984), Vietnam (1995), Laos and Myanmar (1997), and Cambodia (1999)**, bringing the total membership to **10**.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of ASEAN:**
 
 
• To accelerate **economic growth, social progress, and cultural development** in the region.
 
• To promote **regional peace and stability** through respect for justice and the rule of law.
 
• To foster collaboration in various sectors such as **trade, agriculture, industry, transportation, and education**.
 
 
 
• **ASEAN Charter:**
 
 
• The **ASEAN Charter** was signed in **2007** and came into effect in **2008**.
 
• It provides a legal framework and institutional structure for ASEAN, making it a rules-based organization.
 
• It established key bodies such as the **ASEAN Summit** and the **ASEAN Coordinating Council**.
 
 
 
• **Important Summits:**
 
 
• The **ASEAN Summit** is held **annually** and involves the leaders of member states discussing regional issues and cooperation.
 
• Key agreements such as the establishment of the **ASEAN Economic Community (AEC)** have been signed during these summits.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Bangkok:**

 
 
• Bangkok, the capital city of **Thailand**, holds historical importance as the birthplace of ASEAN.
 
• The signing of the **Bangkok Declaration** in this city laid the foundation for regional cooperation in Southeast Asia.
 
 
 
• **ASEAN Economic Community (AEC):**
 
 
• The AEC was established in **2015** to create a single market and production base among ASEAN countries.
 
• It aims to promote the free flow of goods, services, investment, skilled labor, and capital.
 
 
 
• **ASEAN’s Global Influence:**
 
 
• ASEAN has established partnerships with major global powers such as the **United States, China, Japan, India,** and the **European Union**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in regional forums like the **East Asia Summit** and **ASEAN Regional Forum**.
